cases.case_label: Full-length L1 in CHM coding region
cases.mechanism_detail: A full-length L1 retrotransposon inserted into the CHM coding region was identified as a causative defect; details of the transcript effect are not given in the abstract.
cases.quote: These included two partial CHM gene deletions and an insertion of a full-length L1 retrotransposon into the coding region of the CHM gene
